articles.title: FCC approves SpaceX space-based AI data centers
articles.summary: The FCC has dismissed concerns regarding scientific research and approved SpaceX's plan to deploy AI data centers in space, determining that the potential threats fall outside of the agency's regulatory authority.

articles.title: OpenAI combines Chat and Work experiences for ChatGPT
articles.summary: OpenAI is merging its Chat and Work experiences into a single interface. As a result, heavy users of ChatGPT may encounter usage limits much sooner under the new unified usage meter.

articles.title: Canceled Tesla Cyrebruck leads used truck sales
articles.summary: Despite being canceled, the Tesla Cyrebruck has become the fastest-selling used truck in America. It averaged just 39.1 days on the market last month, significantly faster than the 65.5-day average for trucks overall.

articles.title: Anthropic CEO rejects AI control accusations
articles.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei has pushed back against rivals' accusations that he supports surrendering human agency to artificial intelligence, even as major AI companies increasingly automate their own research and model development.

articles.title: 1Password reports internal security breach
articles.summary: Password manager maker 1Password revealed that hackers gained access to an internal employee corporate account. The attacker managed to steal some information regarding customers, though customer passwords remained safe.

articles.title: New York bans AI chatbot toys
articles.summary: New York has enacted a five-year ban on AI chatbot toys. The decision follows new research from Common Sense Media highlighting alarming safety failures, including exposure to inappropriate content and risks to emotional development.

articles.title: Ex-cyber executive accused of ransomware fraud
articles.summary: US prosecutors have accused a former cyber executive of defrauding ransomware victims. The official allegedly secretly paid hackers, charged the victims higher amounts, and pocketed the financial difference.

articles.title: State AGs challenge Character.AI bankruptcy sale
articles.summary: State attorneys general are challenging Character.AI's plan to auction off private chat data through bankruptcy proceedings. The sensitive personal data includes accounts from over 21 million US users, including millions of minors.

articles.title: X updates creator tools with vertical video
articles.summary: Social media platform X is rolling out new creation tools focused on vertical video. The update is part of the company's broader effort to compete directly with popular short-form video platforms like YouTube and Instagram.

articles.title: WhatsApp introduces message scheduling feature
articles.summary: WhatsApp is rolling out a new feature allowing users to schedule messages in advance for both individual and group chats. Users can set messages to send anywhere from 10 minutes to 14 days later.

articles.title: Allstate experiences major multi-day tech outage
articles.summary: Insurance giant Allstate suffered a disruptive multi-day technical outage just ahead of Thanksgiving. The timing proved particularly problematic as millions of Americans prepared to travel for the holiday weekend.

articles.title: EPA reports zero airborne lead after Iowa detonation
articles.summary: The US Army conducted a controlled detonation of over 9,700 pounds of lead azide at an Iowa plant to prevent spontaneous explosions. The EPA subsequently reported zero airborne lead following the blast.

articles.title: 1Password data breach exposes names and emails
articles.summary: A backend security breach at 1Password allowed hackers to steal customer names and email addresses. While vaults and passwords were not exposed, the leaked data could potentially put users at risk of phishing attempts.

articles.title: Fairphone 6 Plus offers modular home repair
articles.summary: The Fairphone 6 Plus smartphone features a modular design with easily replaceable parts intended to extend its lifespan through home repairs. The midrange device is currently available at a discounted price on Amazon.

articles.title: FCC authorizes SpaceX constellation of satellites
articles.summary: The FCC has authorized SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million satellites equipped with AI chips as part of its Starmind initiative. This makes it the first official approval for space-based AI data centers.

articles.title: Nothing reveals AI-powered earbuds and charging case
articles.summary: Nothing has showcased its upcoming AI earbuds ahead of a December release. The earbuds can record calls, while the accompanying charging case features a physical button to record, transcribe, and summarize conversations.

articles.title: Amazon reportedly discussing Muse AI shopping integration
articles.summary: Amazon has reportedly held discussions regarding allowing Meta's Muse AI shopping agent onto its platform. The talks focus on product recommendations and potential impacts on the e-commerce giant's advertising revenue.

articles.title: Kagi launches new privacy-focused email service
articles.summary: Search alternative Kagi has expanded its offerings by launching a rival email service. The new platform pitches an unusual combination of strong privacy guarantees alongside integrated artificial intelligence features.

articles.title: Backblaze clarifies data sharing with advertisers
articles.summary: Backblaze has addressed customer concerns by explaining its data sharing practices with advertisers, explicitly assuring users that their private backup and storage files will not be shared with external third parties.

articles.title: SpaceX cleared to deploy one million satellites
articles.summary: The FCC has officially authorized SpaceX to deploy a massive constellation of one million satellites. If fully realized, this deployment would increase the total number of active satellites currently in orbit by roughly 50 times.

articles.title: Ladybird browser releases first downloadable alpha
articles.summary: An independent browser engine called Ladybird has released its first downloadable alpha version for Linux and macOS. Early testing shows the new browser is surprisingly capable for an independent project.

articles.title: Etsy updates AI policies following seller backlash
articles.summary: Etsy has revised and clarified its terms regarding artificial intelligence following a wave of criticism from its seller community. However, some veteran creators have dismissed the policy updates as mere sugarcoating.

articles.title: Experts warn data centers remain targets in wartime
articles.summary: Military analysts note that cloud infrastructure and data centers face ongoing risks of targeted attacks during wartime due to the numerous strategic advantages they offer to opposing military forces.

articles.title: Huawei found guilty in US trade secret theft
articles.summary: The Department of Justice stated that Huawei made little effort to hide its theft of valuable US trade secrets from companies like T-Mobile and Cisco, resulting in the tech giant facing steep financial penalties.

articles.title: Iowa lead azide detonation raises health questions
articles.summary: Following a controlled military detonation of lead azide in Iowa that generated large smoke plumes, public health concerns and questions have emerged despite previous environmental modeling estimates.

articles.title: French authorities blame Iran for freezer sabotage
articles.summary: France has formally blamed an Iranian state-backed cyber unit for orchestrating a sabotage campaign that disabled hundreds of commercial supermarket freezers across the country.

articles.title: Frontier AI transforms theoretical physics research
articles.summary: Advanced frontier artificial intelligence models are beginning to reshape theoretical physics by solving complex problems in mere moments that previously required top human physicists an entire day to complete.

articles.title: Technical issues impact NASA's aging Mars fleet
articles.summary: Half of NASA's active Mars missions are facing serious operational hurdles. The Perseverance rover is experiencing transmission difficulties with Earth, while the Odyssey orbiter is rapidly depleting its remaining fuel supply.

articles.title: Microsoft cloud outage revealed internal challenges
articles.summary: Internal company memos regarding a historic Microsoft cloud outage exposed significant engineering challenges. The incident prompted a Code Red overhaul and the implementation of ambitious new recovery time goals.

articles.title: State officials block Character.AI data auction
articles.summary: State attorneys general are actively working to block Character.AI from selling user chat logs during bankruptcy proceedings, warning that the proposed data auction includes explicit conversations involving minors.

articles.title: ESA confirms DART impact created massive crater
articles.summary: The European Space Agency's Hera mission has begun capturing images confirming that NASA's DART spacecraft impact successfully carved out a stadium-sized crater on the targeted asteroid.
